name: Parameters.q_eq_pow
summary: q(w) = p^f with f the residue degree, and f is the order of the Frobenius element.

steps.claim: The residue field of w has characteristic p, and q(w) = p^f for some f ≥ 1 (the residue degree).

p^f = p^o with o the order of frobElem: by `frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow` (v = 1, c = id, e = 1, φ the reduction mod w), frobElem^k = 1 if and only if x^{p^k} = x on the residue field of order p^f, i.e. if and only if f ∣ k; numbers with the same multiples are equal (`Nat.dvd_right_iff_eq`).
steps.lean:
simp [*, galOfPlaceInt, p.pow_right_inj Fact.out, ← Nat.dvd_right_iff_eq, eq_comm,
    -frobElem, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, ← frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow (Ideal.Quotient.mk w.1)]
